Direct Known Subclasses:
MessageConnector
public abstract class SchedulingConnector extends Connector
A connector base for transports that send channel buffers over a shared connection. It owns the common channel scheduler and control channel while leaving transport execution and I/O to subclasses. The lifecycle lock serializes scheduling state with shutdown; scheduler operations acquire channel queue locks before scheduler state locks, and release scheduler locks before returning to transport hooks.

    • onSendingRequired

      protected abstract void onSendingRequired()
      Called when the scheduler transitions from idle to having pending work. Implementations should arrange a send attempt without blocking the producer that enqueued the buffer. The hook runs outside the scheduling lifecycle lock, so it must only arrange asynchronous work and must not perform transport I/O or block.

    • onSendingNoLongerRequired

      protected void onSendingNoLongerRequired()
      Called when the scheduler becomes idle. Implementations should asynchronously stop requesting transport write readiness without performing transport I/O or blocking.

    • completeScheduledChannel

      protected final boolean completeScheduledChannel(InternalChannel channel, boolean bufferCompleted)
      Called by a transport sender after a send attempt. An incomplete current buffer keeps that channel selected; a completed buffer allows it to rotate to the tail if more work remains. After a successful completion, this method requests another send attempt when scheduled work remains. The transport hook must enqueue or wake an asynchronous sender rather than sending reentrantly.
      Parameters:
      channel - the serviced channel
      bufferCompleted - whether the current buffer completed successfully
      Returns:
      true if the sender should continue because scheduled work remains

    • restoreSendingInterest

      protected final void restoreSendingInterest(boolean additionalWork)
      Restores transport write readiness according to scheduler work and any transport-specific work that must be serviced on the write path. The check and notification are serialized with channel offers and removals to prevent lost selector wakeups.
      Parameters:
      additionalWork - whether the transport has work that must be serviced by its write-ready callback

    • stopSendingIfIdle

      protected final void stopSendingIfIdle()
      Stops transport write readiness if no channel remains scheduled. The check is serialized with channel offers and removals.
